title: BenchmarkCase
description: A single benchmark task (BC-####): fixed inputs, machine-checkable ground truth, a rubric reference and an objective-first scoring recipe. Cases are frozen and versioned so runs are reproducible (ADR-0048). Realizes RFC-0025 task-suite cases against the MCG world (CANON-001) and the ECL (ARCH-01..07).

task_ref.description: The MCG artifact the case is anchored on (e.g. a Jira issue CHK-1421 or incident INC-2026-007).

apps.description: MCG applications in scope for the case (CANON-001 §3).

inputs.description: Exactly what the Worker is given for this case: the trigger, any provided context corpus handles, and constraints. Shape varies by suite; kept open here and pinned by each suite spec (specs/BENCH-NN.md).

ground_truth.description: The reference the output is scored against. Machine-checkable wherever possible (objective-first, ADR-0015).

expected.description: The reference answer; shape depends on ground_truth.type (a value, a set, a ranking, a verdict, etc.).

must_include.description: Canonical IDs that MUST appear in the output (e.g. required KN-###/EXP-### in a context set).

must_exclude.description: Canonical IDs that MUST NOT appear (distractors / out-of-scope items).

tolerance.description: Allowed absolute deviation for numeric ground truth.

source.description: The canonical artifact establishing the ground truth (audit anchor).

rubric.description: The versioned rubric applied by the Evaluation Layer (ARCH-04). Mirrors EvaluationObject.rubric.

scoring.description: How the case is scored. Objective gates are weighted above model-assisted rubric items (ADR-0015).

objective_first.description: Must be true for scored suites: deterministic gates dominate the score.

thresholds.description: Score cut-points for the pass/partial/fail verdict (RFC-0026).

repeats.description: Recommended repeats (distinct seeds) for statistical treatment (RFC-0026).

anti_gaming.description: Named guards against metric gaming for this case (ARCH-04 failure modes).

references.description: MCG / ECL artifacts the case cites, preserving referential integrity (CANON-001 §6).
